tools.name: run_aeo_report
tools.description: Run the free AI-visibility report for a website (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude coverage, competitor gaps, prioritized fixes). Requires the user's real email — the finished report is emailed there and a shareable report URL is returned. Takes up to ~10 minutes; set wait_seconds up to 50 to wait

tools.name: get_aeo_report_status
tools.description: Poll a previously submitted AEO report job once. status is queued, preparing, needs_review or running (keep polling) or complete, partial or failed (terminal); state carries the phase and reason. When complete or partial, returns the structured report (per-engine breakdown with provenance, recommend
